summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Zipplit landing page. Desktop functionality is excellent with all features working correctly. Mobile responsive design has inconsistent behavior with hamburger menu visibility issues.

design_issues.issue: Hamburger menu visibility is inconsistent - sometimes shows correctly, sometimes remains hidden due to responsive breakpoint timing issues
design_issues.details: Tailwind CSS responsive classes (md:hidden) have timing issues causing inconsistent mobile navigation behavior

responsive_issues.issue: Mobile hamburger menu intermittently fails to show, desktop navigation sometimes visible on mobile
responsive_issues.symptoms: Race condition with CSS loading or viewport detection
responsive_issues.workaround: Page reload sometimes fixes the issue

passed_tests: Navigation bar renders with logo, links (About, For You, How It Works, Careers), and Join Waitlist CTA button
Navigation links scroll to correct sections when clicked
Hero section renders with video background, logo, heading, subheading, two CTA buttons
Marquee bar scrolls continuously with 'Launching Soon' and keywords
Manifesto section renders with 'Fresh Food First' heading, description text, and 3 tags
Audience section renders 3 cards: Working Professionals, Frequent Travellers, Busy Families & Couples
How It Works section renders 3 numbered cards (01 Source Fresh, 02 Cook Daily, 03 Deliver Warm) with images
Careers section renders 4 job role cards (Business Development, Sales Executive, Operations Intern, Operations Manager)
Each career card and Apply Now button links to Google Form: https://forms.gle/gzRLoJWTyQ5QEBkX7
Newsletter form with email input and submit button works (enters email, submits, shows 'Subscribed!')
Footer renders with Zipplit logo, quick links, social icons, copyright, 'Launching Soon' label
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes
Fraunces heading font and Nunito body font are loaded correctly
All sections accessible via smooth scroll navigation
Content matches brand requirements (Deep Teal #0A4849, Fresh Lime #9BCF55)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix mobile responsive design inconsistency. The hamburger menu (mobile-menu-toggle) has visibility issues due to Tailwind CSS responsive breakpoint timing problems. Desktop navigation sometimes shows on mobile. Consider adding explicit CSS media queries or investigating viewport meta tag configuration.
